handoffs.message: BFF handoff packet complete. Explored BFF_API_CONTRACT.md, source_ingestion connectors/base.py, search/gateway.py, openclaw-gateway-adapter/main.py, source-search-prod-hardening.md. Identified 6 query gaps (GAP-01 through GAP-06): missing auth-requirements endpoint, no ingest-job to index readback link, no lineage refs in search results, no DLQ preview GET, no composed source-search health view, OpenClaw audit not proxied in BFF. Documented operator journey (9 steps: connector discovery -> credential provisioning -> ingest job -> poll completion -> source record verification -> index confirmation -> search readback -> health sign-off -> evidence recording). Frontend handoff items in Section 7. No canonical files modified.

Codex2 review approved the BFF handoff packet with two parent-task caveats recorded in support/reviews/P2-SOURCE-SEARCH-LIVE-CONNECTOR-SMOKE-001-SIDECAR-BFF-HANDOFF-codex2-review.md; owner Claude should finalize the sidecar closeout.
